sloka: स ददर्श महात्मानम् जनकम् धर्म वत्सलम् ।सो अभिवाद्य शतानंदम् जनकम् च अति धार्मिकम् ॥१-७०-९॥
transliteration: sa dadarśa mahātmānam janakam dharma vatsalam ।so abhivādya śatānaṁdam janakam ca ati dhārmikam ॥1-70-9॥

translations.english: There he saw the highsouled Janaka devoted to righteousness. Having paid his regards to Satananda and the virtuous king he occupied an exalted seat befitting a king.
